architecture.title: Team + Mailbox 架构
architecture.description: s41 实现文件邮箱通信。每个团队成员有独立的 JSON 邮箱文件。writeToMailbox 追加消息到对方邮箱，readUnreadMessages 读取自己的未读消息。createTeam 初始化团队目录和邮箱文件。
architecture.mermaid:
graph TD
  subgraph team["团队 refactor-team"]
    LEADER["Leader\ncoordinator.json"] 
    W1["Worker-1\nworker-auth.json"]
    W2["Worker-2\nworker-test.json"]
  end

  LEADER -->|writeToMailbox| W1
  LEADER -->|writeToMailbox| W2
  W1 -->|writeToMailbox| LEADER
  W1 -->|writeToMailbox| W2
  W2 -->|writeToMailbox| LEADER

  subgraph storage["文件存储"]
    DIR["~/.agent-cli/teams/refactor-team/"]
    TINFO["team.json"]
    INBOX["inboxes/"]
    I1["coordinator.json"]
    I2["worker-auth.json"]
    I3["worker-test.json"]
    DIR --> TINFO
    DIR --> INBOX
    INBOX --> I1
    INBOX --> I2
    INBOX --> I3
  end

  subgraph msg["TeammateMessage"]
    FROM["from: string"]
    TEXT["text: string"]
    TS["timestamp: string"]
    READ["read: boolean"]
  end

  style LEADER fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#fcd34d
  style W1 fill:#dbeafe,stroke:#93c5fd
  style W2 fill:#dbeafe,stroke:#93c5fd

designDecisions.title: 进程间通信方式
designDecisions.question: 多 Agent 之间如何通信？

options.name: 消息队列 (Redis)
options.cons: 额外依赖，对 CLI 过重

options.name: 文件邮箱 (JSON)
options.pros: 零依赖 + 天然持久化

designDecisions.reason: Claude Code 的方案。CLI 工具是单机场景，文件系统比网络消息队列更可靠。JSON 文件天然持久化，重启后消息不丢。proper-lockfile 解决并发写入。

reference.claudeCodeConcept: TeammateMessage + readMailbox/writeToMailbox + proper-lockfile 并发锁 + formatTeammateMessages XML + 结构化协议消息
reference.difference: 教学版简单 JSON 读写无文件锁；生产版有 proper-lockfile、结构化协议消息路由、XML 格式化、邮箱轮询 hook
reference.whyProduction: 多 Agent 并行写入同一邮箱文件需要文件锁防止数据损坏；结构化协议消息需要特殊路由不能当普通对话处理
